passages.note: House Third Reading roll call showing Wilmeth voting Y on a divided 31-26 final passage, so it is not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted chapter text of the single-subject ESA bill; the added section 15-2401.01 makes every public-school-eligible student a qualified student.
Bill overview listing Wilmeth as a co-sponsor of HB2853 and the governor's signature as Chapter 388.

rows.reasoning: Wilmeth co-sponsored HB 2853 (2022) and voted Y on its 31-26 House Third Reading; the single-subject enacted text adds section 15-2401.01, under which a "qualified student" includes any resident "eligible to enroll in a public school in this state" in "A kindergarten program" or "Any of grades one through twelve", which is universal eligibility rather than "most families, not all". The account is funded by transferring "the monies that would otherwise be allocated to a recipient's prior school district" and spent on tuition "at a qualified school" or "Services provided by a public school", matching the rung on which "education funding follows the student to any school".
